verse.text: For a husband is the head of his wife as Christ is the head of the church. He is the Savior of his body, the church.

video.title: Men - How to Be the Spiritual Leader When Your Wife Is More Spiritual

reflection: Leading your home well isn't about having all the answers or being the loudest voice at the table — it's about showing up, day after day, and pointing your family toward Christ through small, faithful acts. Just as Christ laid down His life for His church, headship means going first in humility: first to apologize, first to pray, first to serve. Your kids and your wife don't need a perfect leader; they need a present, faithful one.
